title: Receipts
about: A receipt is built from the decision and its figures by templates. Each case reuses the inputs of a policy case (`from`) and states the exact headline and the lines that must appear. `noRupee` means the receipt must contain no rupee amount. The property check runs over every single-order policy case: every rupee amount in the headline and the lines must equal one of the amounts in the decision's figures, and a decision with no figures must produce no rupee amount at all.
